description: This file defines the RequestCompressionMiddleware class used in the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles compressing request payloads by adding middleware that intercepts requests to apply compression algorithms like gzip based on configurations and request parameters.

classes.name: RequestCompressionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for compressing request payloads in AWS SDK for PHP, supporting gzip encoding and size-based request compression logic.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that returns an instance of RequestCompressionMiddleware with provided configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with a handler and configuration parameters, setting up compression size and API details.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Entry point to compress requests if conditions are met, including size and streaming considerations.

methods.name: compressRequestBody
methods.description: Compresses the request body using the determined encoding and updates headers.

methods.name: determineEncoding
methods.description: Selects the encoding method based on available encodings and the encoding map.

methods.name: shouldCompressRequestBody
methods.description: Determines whether the request body should be compressed based on size, configuration, and stream properties.

methods.name: hasStreamingTraitWithoutRequiresLength
methods.description: Checks if the operation input has streaming members without a length requirement, influencing compression decision.

methods.name: determineMinimumCompressionSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum size for compression, supporting static and dynamic configurations.

methods.name: isValidCompressionSize
methods.description: Validates that a given size is numeric, non-negative, and within acceptable bounds (0 to 10MB).
